title.zh: 将索索贡省Prieto Diaz市镇Carayat居民点改设为村的法案
title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Carayat, in the Municipality of Prieto Diaz, Province of Sorsogon, into a Barrio
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Carayat, in the Municipality of Prieto Diaz, Province of Sorsogon, into a Barrio
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Carayat tại Đô thị Prieto Diaz, Tỉnh Sorsogon thành Barrio
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Carayat ในเทศบาล Prieto Diaz จังหวัด Sorsogon เป็น บาริโอ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio Carayat di Kotamadya Prieto Diaz, Provinsi Sorsogon menjadi Barrio
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Carayat di Perbandaran Prieto Diaz, Wilayah Sorsogon kepada Barrio

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1028_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Carayat, in the Municipality of Prieto Diaz, Province of Sorsogon, is hereby converted into a barrio.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1954.
